modules.name: Loop contract
modules.description: The five ingredients (program, predicate, check, ledger, termination), command vs criterion checks, why context resets, and the loop.md file shape. Read before the first iteration.

modules.name: Stop signals
modules.description: What wasting iterations looks like — goalpost-moving, activity without progress, wrong problem — and what is not a stop signal. The semantic layer loop_state.py cannot check. Read before a long loop.

modules.name: External wait
modules.description: Waiting on someone else's state: no work per round, short pause plus one status check, bounded rounds, fail loud at the cap. Read when the loop waits instead of working.
